iti77:2.1: bhidurāyaṁ → bhindantāyaṁ (sya-all, pts) | Bhidurāyaṁ → bhindantāyaṁ (cck: syā. pī. ka.) | Bhindantāyaṁ → bhindantāyaṁ, M.; bhinnoyaṁ, B. C.; bhidarāyaṁ, D. E. (see the Uddāna, and cp. skr. bhidura); bhirūayaṁ, P.; bhirubhayaṁ, Pa. A. mentions two readings (bhindantāyaṁ and bhidurāyaṁ?), but the MS. is corrupt here (Piṇḍāyan-ti piṇḍato ayaṁ kāyo ti . . . bhiru bhedanasīlo . . . tinnarāyanti pi pāṭho); the explanation is bhedanasīlo. (pts note) | virāgadhammaṁ → virāgadh-, B. A.; virāgūdh-, M. D. E.; virāgudh-, C. P.; see the gāthā. (pts note) | upadhī → -ī, only M.; all other MSS. -i. (pts note)
iti77:2.3: vuccati → Etam- only in M. (pts note)
iti77:3.1: bhiduraṁ → bhindanaṁ (bj: kesuci); bhindantaṁ (bj: sī, aṭṭhakathā, sīmu) | bhiduraṁ → bhindantaṁ (cck: syā. pī. ka.) | bhindantaṁ → bhindantaṁ, only M.; bhindanaṁ, B. P. Pa. D. E.; bhinnaṁtaṁ, C. (pts note)
iti77:3.2: viññāṇañca virāgunaṁ → viññāṇaṁ ca pabhaṅguraṁ (bj) | pabhaṅguraṁ → virāgunaṁ (bj: sī, aṭṭhakathā, sīmu); vīrāgikaṁ (bj: sī tālapaṇṇakesuci); pabhaṅgunaṁ (bj: syā) | virāgunaṁ → virāgikaṁ (cck: ka. sī.); pabhaṅguṇaṁ (cck: syā.) | virāgikaṁ → virāguṇaṁ, C. P.; -naṁ, B. M. Pa.; pabhaṁguṇaṁ, D. E. (pts note)
iti77:3.4: jātimaraṇamaccagā → jātimaraṇamajjagā (sya-all) | jātimaraṇamaccagā sampatvā → jātimaraṇamajjhagā saṁpatvā (pts) | jātimaraṇamaccagā → majjhago (bj: sī, aṭṭhakathā, sīmu – magājjha – sī, aṭṭhakathā) | jātimaraṇam-ajjhagā → ajjagā, M. (pts note)
iti77:3.5: santiṁ → santi, D. E. P. A.; santaṁ, B. C. M. Pa. (pts note)
iti77:3.6: kaṅkhati → kāla saṁkhati, D. E. (pts note) | bhāvitatto → -atto, D. E. M.; -attho, B. C. P. Pa. (pts note)
